The ten numbered files are 15-second excerpts of the MP3s supplied by the website owner, in the requested playlist order. Audio tags are stripped so the player does not display the answer. They are kept local with the birthday website.

Clip source paths and editable start times: ../../tools/disco-clips.json
Regenerate: python tools/prepare-disco.py clips (from the project root; uses the local .tools/python FFmpeg package).
